feedback: Accepted. The 5-state chain faithfully encodes the task under the framework's step-wise valuation semantics: (u0,has_key)->u1 records the first holding move, and (u1,has_key)->u2 fires on any later step where has_key is still in the valuation — whether the agent keeps carrying or drops and re-picks up — which is exactly 'be holding the key on at least two different moves' (two distinct steps with has_key true; one transition per step prevents both rewards on a single move). Since has_key is a persistent condition evaluated at every time point, no key_lost-based machinery or regression is needed: the hold count is monotone history and dropping later cannot invalidate it. Ordering is consistent with the environment constraints — door_open cannot occur before has_key, and any toggle step has the key in hand, which forces u2 to be reached before the first opening, so (u2,door_open)->u3 always fires at the first open step and (u3,at_goal)->u4 at the final goal step; at_goal is last-step-only and u4's else self-loop makes it absorbing. Irrelevant events (key_lost, drops after u2, door shut/reopened after u3, turns and moves) are all covered by per-state else self-loops in all five states with no spurious or repeated rewards, and no explicit regression transitions are required because a closed-but-unlocked door does not negate the achieved opening — the agent must reopen it to pass, which the u3 else loop absorbs without double-paying door_open. Rewards are dense across all four progress transitions (0.1, 0.1, 0.2, 1.0), positive and bounded (total 1.4), with implicit 0 on self-loops. Format matches the paper exactly: REWARD_MACHINE header, nonempty FINAL_STATES with declared and accepting u4, transition labels restricted to single predicates or else, and (state, event, next-state) reward triples. The machine is compact (5 states is minimal for count-to-two plus door plus goal) and reachable: replaying the seed-0 trace yields u0->u1 at pickup, u1->u2 on the next holding step, u2->u3 at the toggle, and u3->u4 at the goal step, collecting the full 1.4.

The guard on the previous valuation is safe (a complete valuation dict is truthy; a missing one yields a falsy result, consistent with all-false at the first step). The inlined has_key/door_open logic in `key_lost` is semantically identical to the declared functions. No imports, no actions, no mutations of the environment or episode memory, and the code is syntactically valid Python.
